subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should these 14 action updates land as one grouped supply-chain change after exact-head verification, or should the secret-bearing Codex, token, Docker, and CodeQL updates be reviewed separately?
rationale: The patch is mechanically coherent, but multiple updated actions execute with sensitive credentials or publishing/security privileges, and CI does not exercise every affected trigger; accepting that grouped review boundary requires owner judgment.

options.title: Verify and land the group
options.body: Rebase, finish exact-head workflow checks, inspect the sensitive upstream deltas, and merge the grouped immutable-SHA refresh if those checks remain clean.

options.title: Split sensitive actions
options.body: Separate Codex, app-token, Docker, and CodeQL updates from lower-risk setup and housekeeping actions for narrower review and rollback.

options.title: Pause the grouped update
options.body: Keep the existing pins until direct Codex inspection and representative release or dispatch workflow proof are available.

recommendation.title: Verify and land the group
recommendation.body: Rebase, finish exact-head workflow checks, inspect the sensitive upstream deltas, and merge the grouped immutable-SHA refresh if those checks remain clean.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history and timeline involvement make `steipete` the strongest available routing candidate for release and automation risk acceptance.
